text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Heh, hehehe...! Yes, this godly plot twist!
This is definitely going to be a masterpiece...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna go as far as I can!
No one's gonna stop meeeee--!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I did draw so much yesterday...
Ugh, maybe I pushed myself a little too hard...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! Thanks to that, I drew a great storyboard!
A little headache is nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now that I've calmed down and reread it—I don't think it's actually that funny...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Did I let the excitement get the better of me...?!
...Ouch, ouch...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Kiseki was troubled by a headache
for quite a while...
